instructions.intake.pointer: AGS intake: skip rereading the shared intake and selection criteria in {path} only while this context keeps both proof of a successful read and the text; otherwise, including after compaction, read that section before task work and follow it. Failed or partial reads and other revisions do not count as a successful read.
instructions.intake.skills:
Skills are split by purpose. For each user message, before answering or the next tool, match what it calls for (questions and check requests included) against the targets below by the judgment you will actually make, not names or keywords, and call every match now, before that judgment or action. An earlier skill's guidance covers only what it was called for. Before doing work that can be completed and verified on its own, consider delegating it to a subagent; the brief names goal, scope, forbidden areas, write ownership, chosen skills and completion and verification criteria, and never hands off waiting such as watching results or polling.

instructions.sessionMessage.guide: After send: autoWake available → no extra wake; no-live-relay/unsupported → wake once by host only if needed now, and tell the user the confirmed delivery state and that AGS auto-wake is unavailable; wake-unanswered → the wake is not answered yet. Report only confirmed queueing/delivery, not autoWake. Bodiless wakes/messages never stop work; never guess unreceived bodies.
